differences.justification: EndpointBasedEvaluatorDefinition is part of the Evaluations V1Preview surface, constructed only through BetaEvaluatorsClient / BetaEvaluatorsAsyncClient. Its parent EvaluatorDefinition and sibling subtypes (CodeBasedEvaluatorDefinition, RubricBasedEvaluatorDefinition, PromptBasedEvaluatorDefinition) were already @Beta in 2.6.1; this type was missing the annotation due to a generation inconsistency, now corrected.
